integrity: Proof is analytic. Symbolic verification uses independently constructed real multilinear normal-form calculations at three rational parameter points, plus a generic symbolic coefficient identity; numerical evidence is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Local nondegenerate Hopf theorem for every fixed sigma>0 and kappa>epsilon>0; no global uniqueness of attractors, no global cycle for arbitrarily large forcing, no uniform neighborhood across an unbounded parameter domain. The exact cubic coefficient is in a stated complex-signal normalization.
title: All-parameter supercritical Hopf onset in a saturating Lorenz-type oscillator
